instruction: Search the Internet for how to enable smart case search in Vim (case-sensitive when uppercase is used), then configure my Vim accordingly.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Vim smart case search. Verifies ~/.vimrc contains 'set smartcase' command.
metadata.verification: Script verifies Vim configuration file for specific settings. Uses grep to check ~/.vimrc content.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies ALL requirements for Vim smart case search: both 'set ignorecase' (or 'ic') AND 'set smartcase' (or 'scs') must be present in ~/.vimrc.
Properly excludes commented lines using grep pattern to avoid false positives from lines like '" set smartcase'.
Supports both full setting names and standard Vim abbreviations (ignorecase/ic, smartcase/scs).
Correct semantic logic: outputs success message only when BOTH required settings are present and uncommented.
Uses appropriate regex '^[[:space:]]*set[[:space:]]+(setting)([[:space:]]|$)' to match valid Vim set commands.
